snippet.title: Shattered Chess Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Enter the world of Shattered Chess - a fast-paced roguelike twist on chess where insane combo chains, game-breaking synergies and brutal bosses redefine every run.

⚔️ Build unique strategies with over 100 passives and effects
♟️ Upgrade piece movements and create powerful combos
👑 Defeat challenging bosses across 5 difficulty levels
🔥 Conquer Normal Mode or survive Boss Rush Mode

Official Release Date: June 5, 2026

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4131940/Shattered_Chess/
